Title: Python foundations
Why: The language basics and a clean project setup you will reuse forever.

Steps.Text: Work through the official tutorial up to modules and classes.
Create a virtual environment and install a package into it.
Learn to read tracebacks and use the debugger.

Title: Modern project tooling
Why: Packaging, typing, linting and tests: the habits that make Python projects maintainable.

Steps.Text: Set up pyproject.toml, uv and Ruff in a small project.
Add type hints and run a type checker.
Write tests with pytest, including fixtures and parametrization.

Title: Build APIs and handle concurrency
Why: Validate data at the edges and pick the right concurrency model.

Steps.Text: Build a small FastAPI service with Pydantic models.
Learn asyncio and when it helps.
Understand the GIL and when to use processes.
